Show HN: Yolt – Your Personal TV
items.summary: Clipping tools are ubiquitous these days. Videos can be bulky, and hosted options are expensive. Yolt never stores a video, full or clipped. A clip is just a start and end time on the original YouTube video, played through YouTube’s embedded player. An LLM ranks the best moments, and new episodes are clipped automatically. The TV tab plays all your clips back to back, with a QR code to open the full episode on your phone at that timestamp. items.title: Show HN: I've become the dumb one, so I made a shortcut to ask Claude
items.summary: Whenever Claude hands a step back to me, a signup, onboarding or an API key Im lost; and most of the time stuck. No context, stuck on something easy. Me and Claude have switched seats quite fast: claude does the work and I'm the one who needs to be told what to do. And speed matters now. I have Claude Code sessions running all day, so I made one shortcut. Control-Option-A sends the window I'm looking at to a session and the answer shows up next to my work. items.summary: Hey HN, this is Alexander from Hatchet ( https://github.com/hatchet-dev/hatchet ). We’re releasing a new open-source project today called Brickie. Brickie lets you run sandboxes in your own cloud account, primarily targeting EKS on AWS. Sandboxes are an incredibly useful primitive for agentic applications. They serve two main functions: (1) a way for the agent to safely execute untrusted code, and (2) a durable filesystem for agents to preserve their state via snapshots. items.title: Show HN: Chili3D – Open-source browser CAD with parametric/push-pull modeling
items.summary: Author here. Since my previous Show HN ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=44238171 ), Chili3D has added three core modeling modules: - Parametric: feature-tree editing + sketch constraints, with automatic downstream rebuild. - AI-assisted: natural-language modeling in the browser with your own API key, producing editable features. - Push/pull: history-free direct modeling—push/pull faces or profiles with automatic cut/join. Repo: https://github.com/xiangechen/chili3d Demo: https://chili3d.com Feedback welcome.
